verdict.rationale: The evidence shows AI-applied automatic labels, junk filtering, and API integrations. None of it documents user-defined rules that trigger actions on mail events, such as auto-scan, auto-forward, or auto-shred when a condition matches. Automatic labeling and junk filtering are adjacent vendor-driven features, and the APIs are developer building blocks, so neither earns credit toward user-configurable event rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
